page.overview:
Who is Endai?

At , tries to decide whether he should head back south or continue north. Due to the danger presented by heading north, he decides to return to .

As he travels, will sometimes speak to himself. He thinks about putting in and how much he likes . He also reminds himself to shoot in the eye and that can be found by cutting grass.

When speaks to , he recognizes him as a courageous adventurer from his look. He reasons that 's "roguish look" makes him appear as though he would try to infiltrate . Getting into the is one of many things considers a possibility in life, among catching , swimming, and sleeping. In fact, he encourages to do so and find that lost treasures of the .

According to Endai, shopkeepers sell their best wares during rain because they get less customers. Climbing during rain also isn't something he recommends, since it makes the rocks slippery.
